name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@v31
        with:
          github_access_token: ${{ github.token }}

      # The flake's only job is to refuse with the migration notice.
      - name: Every entry point fails with the notice
        run: |
          for target in . .#omp .#codex .#claude; do
            if nix run "$target" 2>err; then echo "$target ran; it must fail" >&2; exit 1; fi
            grep -q "juspay/AI has moved" err || { cat err >&2; exit 1; }
          done
          if nix build --no-link . 2>err; then echo "build must fail" >&2; exit 1; fi
          grep -q "juspay/AI has moved" err

# AI

**Moved.** Run:

```bash
nix run github:juspay/agent-distro -- github:juspay/skills
```

See [agent-distro](https://github.com/juspay/agent-distro) for details.
